pick.headline: Havel elected first president of the Czech Republic
pick.summary: On 26 January 1993 the Czech parliament elected Vaclav Havel the first president of the independent Czech Republic.
pick.significance: The dissident playwright had led the Velvet Revolution and was the last president of Czechoslovakia.
